topic.label: Hedge Funds and Private Funds
topic.desc: Hedge Funds and Private Funds: Private Equity and Venture Capital, Hedge Fund Strategies, Fund Structures: Onshore and Offshore, Prime Brokerage and Fund Operations, Funds and ETFs and Subscribing, Reporting and Tracking.

concepts.label: Prime Brokerage and Fund Operations
concepts.desc: Prime brokers, fund administrators, NAV calculation, custody, margin and securities lending.

concepts.label: Private Equity and Venture Capital
concepts.desc: Buyouts, growth and venture funds, capital calls, J-curve, carried interest and exits.

concepts.label: Hedge Fund Strategies
concepts.desc: Long/short equity, global macro, event driven, relative value, credit and quant strategies.

concepts.label: Fund Structures: Onshore and Offshore
concepts.desc: Delaware LPs, Cayman funds, master-feeder structures, side pockets and why each is used.

concepts.label: Subscribing, Reporting and Tracking
concepts.desc: How investors subscribe and redeem: eligibility, subscription documents, lockups, gates, and investor reporting.

concepts.label: Funds and ETFs
concepts.desc: Mutual funds, ETFs, index funds, expense ratios, tracking error and fund structures.

skills.label: Fund Ops Map
skills.desc: Maps a fund's service providers (prime broker, administrator, auditor, custodian) and what each does.

skills.label: PE Fund Terms Explainer
skills.desc: Explains fund terms: management fee, carry, hurdle, waterfall and capital calls.

skills.label: Strategy Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a hedge fund strategy's return sources, risks and typical leverage.

skills.label: Fund Structure Selector
skills.desc: Compares onshore, offshore and parallel fund structures for an investor base.

skills.label: Master-Feeder Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a master-feeder structure, which investors use which feeder and why.

skills.label: Subscription Guide
skills.desc: Explains how an investor subscribes to a fund: eligibility, documents, KYC, lockups and redemptions.

skills.label: Fund Comparator
skills.desc: Compares funds by holdings, fees, tracking error and structure.

mcp.name: QuantConnect MCP
mcp.desc: QuantConnect MCP server: algorithmic trading research, backtests, projects and quantitative strategy code on the LEAN engine.

mcp.name: Yahoo Finance MCP
mcp.desc: Yahoo Finance MCP server: stock prices, historical quotes, company financial statements, holders, options chains and news.
